## Summary

Describe the problem and the approach used to solve it.

## Validation

- [ ] Hardware-independent tests pass.
- [ ] Documentation and configuration examples were updated when behavior changed.
- [ ] No credentials, private addresses, personal paths, logs, or generated builds were added.
- [ ] Robot-facing changes were tested in dry-run mode first.
- [ ] Hardware testing performed, or the reason it was not possible is documented below.

## Hardware impact

Describe affected hardware, network ports, command paths, calibration assumptions, and safety considerations. Write `None` when the change is hardware-independent.
